movement_narrative: In the last seven days, the pipeline saw six transitions, all seeded, concentrated in marketingqualifiedlead (two), salesqualifiedlead (two), and opportunity (one), with two contacts driving the movement: Vikramn@darwinbox.com moving to lead and Abose@greythr.com progressing from marketingqualifiedlead to salesqualifiedlead on 2026-09-05.
